name: continuum
description: Continuum 无限遛弯 · 道行之而成。

scripts.check:cel: node tools/cel_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,coast,alpine,valley,river,desert,city,space --styles real,cel --check tools/look/cel.json
scripts.check:print: node tools/print_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,coast,alpine,valley,river,desert,city,space --styles print --check tools/look/print.json
scripts.check:pixel: node tools/pixel_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,coast,alpine,valley,river,desert,city,cavern,inferno,abyss,heaven,space,upside,meadow --styles real,pixel --check tools/look/pixel.json
scripts.check:ground: node tools/ground_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots alpine,valley,desert --styles real --check tools/look/ground.json --against tools/look/ground-baseline.json
scripts.check:block: node tools/block_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,alpine,valley,river,coast,upside --styles real,block --check tools/look/block.json
scripts.check:ao: node tools/ao_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots wood,city,valley --styles real --check tools/look/targets-ao.json
scripts.check:air: node tools/air_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,coast,alpine,valley,desert,sun --styles real --check tools/look/targets-air.json
scripts.check:car: node tools/car_check.mjs --check && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood --styles real --check tools/look/targets-car.json
scripts.check:surface: node tools/surface_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,valley,city,wood --styles real --check tools/look/targets-surface.json --against tools/look/surface.json
scripts.check:water: node tools/water_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots river,coast,riverlow,coastlow --styles real --check tools/look/targets-water.json --against tools/look/water.json
scripts.check:trees: node tools/trees_check.mjs && node tools/look.mjs --shots wood,woodstill,river,alpine,hills,meadow --styles real --check tools/look/targets-trees.json --against tools/look/trees.json
